<a name="Rahmati2025"></a>

## Role of forelimb morphology in muscle sensorimotor functions during locomotion in the cat

Rahmati Seyed Mohammadali, Klishko Alexander N, Martin Ramaldo S, Bunderson Nate E, Meslie Jeswin A, Nichols T Richard, Rybak Ilya A, Frigon Alain, Burkholder Thomas J, Prilutsky Boris I; 2025; The Journal of physiology; 603; 447-487

[10.1113/JP287448](https://doi.org/10.1113/JP287448)

**Used for:** Forelimb source anatomy, measured/pooled EMG, joint-angle definitions and source muscle laws.

[Included full article](Open_Access_Papers/Rahmati2025.pdf) · CC BY-NC (publisher notice in article); separate from code MIT

Prilutsky Boris I., Klishko Alexander N., Weber Douglas J., Lemay Michel A.; 2015; Springer Series in Computational Neuroscience; 273-307

[10.1007/978-1-4939-3267-2_10](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4939-3267-2_10)

<a name="DeGroote2016"></a>
